description: Fires right after the opponent, who moved first (odd ply), drops a stone in column 5 or 4; strongest on the very first move of the game (opening in col 5 is the maximum, col 4 next). In later positions it fires only if the history is favourable: opponent stones in columns 3-5 raise it, while my stones in columns 0, 1 or 4 and opponent stones in column 0 suppress it. Never fires when I moved first.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changed move probabilities by at most 0.01 on 4 positions.
notes: Layer-0 unit behaving like a token mixture: last-token gate (odd ply, col 5>4) times history. Program: hand-set additive per-(player,column) stone weights from minimal pairs, averaged over ply, threshold 0.55. Dev F1 0.225 (H1 only gate) -> 0.433 -> 0.446 -> 0.482 -> 0.511 (P 0.53, R 0.50, AUROC 0.74). Sim share 0.05 (unit has no measurable effect; negative side unmodelled). Clear interactions (e.g. 1,0,5,3,3 does not fire). Could not beat dev max 1.653 (ply-1 col 5). Score call 1 was wasted by a truncated-output rerun.
